verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair question for a team collaboration tool like Trello, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes kanban-style boards with a 'visual layout' for tracking tasks and general design-team collaboration. Neither amounts to a freeform shared whiteboard canvas, so this is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
